about: English -> Simplified Chinese (mainland, 普通话) glossary for the RH explainer (script.py + i18n/strings_en.json + the Artifact player). Terms checked against zh.wikipedia.org (zh-cn) on 2026-11-22. Fields: category, en, zh, spoken (what the Mandarin voice should say when it differs from zh), note.
rules: Claimed proof: 待确认的证明 (or 声称的证明 when the sentence is about Alpöge's claim); never 已被证明 / 已解决 / 证明了黎曼猜想 in the narrator's own voice. 已被证明 is right only for the curves-over-finite-fields analogue (Hasse, Weil, Deligne).

The Lean and Mathlib communities' joint statement (联合声明, endorsed / 背书 by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative) certified (认证) the CLASSICAL RH only; 完全确信 appears only inside their attributed, translated quote.
Sutherland's MIT page 报告称 the library also proves the on-the-line statement for every Dirichlet L-function = 这一意义上的广义黎曼猜想; other L-functions 未经检查; the note only 预期 ERH 假以时日.
Clay: 先发表（合格刊物），再过两年，然后获得普遍认可.
The mechanism (θ 提升链的周期、可除性、X/m + m 的平衡) is attributed to 短文 and AI 辅助撰写的导读 / 研读代码的人, never the narrator's voice.
The timeline is 'Claude 整理/提供的粗略时间线（据短文）'.
Quotes keep their attribution; quotes from English sources get （译文） on screen; Riemann's German line: '黎曼，1859（据 D. R. Wilkins 英译）'.
Disambiguation: 内核 = Lean's kernel, θ 核 = theta kernel; 编译 = compile code, 整理 = compile a timeline; 声明 = public statement, 命题 = a theorem's statement; 对称变换群, not 对称群 (= S_n).
Typography: full-width Chinese punctuation （），：；“” ……; Latin names, code, file and tool names verbatim; numbers in 万 / 万亿; dates YYYY 年 M 月 D 日.

Voice: [display|spoken] — captions keep Latin names (Levent Alpöge, Kevin Buzzard, Andrew Sutherland), the voice says the transliteration in 'spoken'; Greek letters are spoken as in the 'spoken' field.

glossary.note: Default in the narrator's own voice (as web/player.html already writes). Use 声称的证明 only where the sentence is about Alpöge's claim (他声称找到的证明). NEVER in the narrator's voice: 已被证明 / 已证明 / 已解决 / 证明了黎曼猜想 / 被攻克. Caption 'a claimed proof' -> 待确认的证明; 'and a claimed proof in Lean' -> 以及一份用 Lean 写成、待确认的证明; '(= RH, claimed)' -> （= 黎曼猜想，待确认）.

glossary.en: he wrote that he believes that ... he has found a proof
glossary.zh: 他写道，他相信自己……找到了一个证明
glossary.note: Keep both hedges: 他写道 (reported) + 他相信 (his belief). Note: 'I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.'
Alpöge's own words; keep 'Alpöge, working with Claude'. Not 'Claude 独自证明' nor 'Alpöge 独自'. Caption 'Levent Alpöge, working with Claude: a 4-page note' -> Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 合作：一篇 4 页的短文.

'the Lean and Mathlib communities' joint statement' -> Lean 与 Mathlib 社区的联合声明 (statement BY the communities; the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative only endorse it). Do not confuse with 命题 (a theorem's statement).

glossary.en: endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative
glossary.zh: 获 Lean FRO 与 Mathlib Initiative 背书
glossary.note: Not '由 Lean FRO 发布/认证'. 背书 = endorse; avoid 认可 here (reserved for Clay's 'general acceptance').

Subject is always the joint statement: Lean 与 Mathlib 的声明所认证的，是经典黎曼猜想. Scope = the classical RH only (Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis). Status-row label 'certified' -> 已认证 (its body line names who certified: Lean + Mathlib, 11 月 21 日).
Only inside the attributed quotation, never as the narrator's verdict. 'the November twenty-first statement of full confidence' -> 11 月 21 日那份表示“完全确信”的声明 (keep the quotation marks).

glossary.en: We have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct
glossary.zh: 我们完全确信，Alpöge 对黎曼猜想的证明是正确的
glossary.note: A QUOTE (Lean + Mathlib communities, 21 Nov 2026), translated from English: on screen add （译文） to the attribution line; narration introduces it with 原话是 / 引述如下. On-screen 3-line split ('We have full confidence that' / 'Alpöge's proof of the Riemann' / 'Hypothesis is correct') -> 我们完全确信， / Alpöge 对黎曼猜想的 / 证明是正确的。 Short form '“We have full confidence that Alpöge’s proof … is correct”' -> “我们完全确信，Alpöge 的证明……是正确的”（译文）.
What the joint statement certifies (as opposed to GRH / ERH).
Keep the attribution verb: Andrew Sutherland 在 MIT 的验证页面报告称，这个代码库也对每个狄利克雷 L 函数证明了同样的“零点都在线上”的命题. Not stated as the narrator's fact.

glossary.en: GRH in that sense / the generalized hypothesis, in that sense
glossary.zh: 这一意义上的广义黎曼猜想
glossary.note: GRH here = every Dirichlet L-function (Sutherland's scope note). zh.wikipedia 广义黎曼猜想 uses the same split: GRH = Dirichlet L-functions, ERH = Dedekind zeta functions (and notes the broader usage).

glossary.en: other kinds of L-functions haven't been checked
glossary.zh: 其他类型的 L 函数尚未经过检查
glossary.note: Status label 'not checked' -> 未经检查. Body: 'other L-functions (Dedekind, Hecke, …); the note only "expects" ERH' -> 其他 L 函数（戴德金、赫克……）；短文只是“预期”扩展黎曼猜想（ERH）.

glossary.en: expects (the Extended RH) with more time
glossary.zh: 预期（假以时日也能得到扩展黎曼猜想）
glossary.note: Note: 'I expect, with more time, the Extended Riemann Hypothesis too'. Only an expectation: never 已证明 / 声称已证明 ERH. Narration: Alpöge 只是预期，假以时日，也能得到其中之一——扩展黎曼猜想.
As in web/player.html. 'there's no human-readable proof yet' -> 目前还没有供人阅读的证明. Status label 'not yet' -> 尚无.

glossary.en: he'll write it properly / "write it properly"
glossary.note: Quote from the note (English): on screen 'Alpöge: he will "write it properly"' -> Alpöge：他会“好好写出来”（译文）.
End-card word; pairs with 尚未解释清楚.

glossary.zh: 尚未用人类的语言解释清楚
glossary.note: End-card short form: 尚未解释清楚. Not 'not yet understood' (fact-check changed that).

glossary.zh: 经过了机器检查，但还没有用人类的语言解释清楚

glossary.note: Keep the conditional in the closing lines.

glossary.note: Fact-check wording: not 'no human has read' (没有人读过).

'two errors, as the AI-assisted guides read the code:' -> AI 辅助撰写的导读对代码的解读：两项误差：
